prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: night sea water with bioluminescent plankton: deep blue water with sparse bright cyan sparkles in the wave crests The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a SQUARE, seamless tileable top-down JRPG map ground texture of deep blue night sea water with sparse bright cyan bioluminescent plankton flecks nestled in short wave crests. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, crisply hand-placed, consistent square art-pixel grid across image (roughly 8x8 output pixels per art pixel), hard pixel edges exclusively, cohesive clusters of 3–10 art pixels, no antialiasing, blur, soft gradients, photographic texture, random noise, or checkerboard dithering. 4–6 discrete color shades: dark saturated violet-blue troughs, rich navy/indigo midtones, muted blue wave ridges, restrained cyan flecks (not glowing). Subtle varied short irregular horizontal wave bands and tiny cyan markings, evenly distributed throughout without any dominant feature. Orthographic map surface seen directly from above, no horizon or perspective. Clean base colors under neutral even ambient lighting; absolutely no cast shadows, darkness filter, actual glow, lamps or vignetting. Texture fills full canvas edge to edge, no borders, objects, characters or text. IMPORTANT: precisely seamless repeat in BOTH directions: features crossing left/right edges align and continue exactly, likewise top/bottom edges. Uniform visual density at all edges and center.
